trailblazer-physical.name: Trailblazer (Physical)
trailblazer-physical.title: The Nameless
trailblazer-physical.bioSub: A stowaway from beyond the stars.
trailblazer-physical.description: The Trailblazer wields a baseball bat and fights with raw physical power. They are the key to the Stellaron's mystery.

features.desc: Strong single-target and AoE physical attacks.

bioContent: The Trailblazer woke up with no memory aboard the Astral Express. They are the key to the Stellaron crisis and are determined to find their past.
Their journey takes them across the cosmos, meeting new allies and facing impossible odds.

skills.name: Starbreaker

trailblazer-fire.name: Trailblazer (Fire)

dan-heng.name: Dan Heng

bioContent: Dan Heng is a member of the Astral Express crew, serving as a guard. He is always accompanied by his spear, which he wields with great skill.
Little is known about his past, but he seems to carry a heavy burden. He keeps to himself, but his loyalty to the Express is unwavering.

march-7th.name: March 7th
